A1.justification: Both PDFs describe EarthDial. Their complete main texts, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: v1 reports original EarthDial evaluations across remote-sensing tasks, quantitative ablations, and qualitative results, including appendix experiments.

after.justification: v2 retains original EarthDial evaluations and appendix experiments, with revised scores and additional comparison and ablation results.

M1.justification: The InternViT/Phi-3-mini architecture, MLP connector, adaptive-resolution processing, data fusion, and three-stage training procedure remain unchanged. Added ablation configurations do not alter the proposed method.

E1.justification: The dataset and task inventories match between v1 Table A.2 and v2 Table A.1. The headline count changes to 44, but no corresponding dataset, modality, or task addition is documented. Urban heat island evaluation remains present.

E2.justification: v2 Table 6 adds InternVL2-8B to the referred-object detection comparison, alongside the retained GeoChat and InternVL2-4B baselines. Its earlier participation in other experiments does not make this comparison unchanged.

E3.justification: QuakeSet's reported split changes from train/test to train/val/test in the dataset inventory. v2 also introduces experimental controls with pretraining but no adaptive high resolution, and with max-pooling fusion. These reported changes do not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: v2 Table 13 extends the existing ablation with a control separating adaptive-resolution benefits from pretraining and a max-pooling alternative to average pooling and bilinear fusion. The appendix LoRA comparison, qualitative examples, and failure cases are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests. The statistical reporting practice remains unchanged.

E6.justification: SAR ship-detection results are substantially revised: small/large/multiple-object mAP@0.5 changes from 27.10/66.6/27.17 to 12.14/35.56/6.06 in v1 Table 4 versus v2 Table 5. Additional revisions affect classification, GeoChat-Instruct detection, HIT-UAV captioning, MUDS, xBD, and UHI results. New baseline and ablation entries also appear. The PDFs do not explain the cause of these numerical revisions.

T1.justification: No formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised. Correcting the bottom-right bounding-box coordinate label is a notation correction to an already specified representation.

C1.justification: The abstract changes its coverage claim from 43 applications to 44 datasets; the contribution list and conclusion change 37 downstream tasks to 44. The central unified-model and 11.11M-instruction dataset contributions remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The interpretations of multimodal fusion, temporal processing, and full fine-tuning are retained. Appendix explanations of ambiguous objects, limited SAR training examples, subtle changes, and confusing scene classes also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: New Table 3 documents existing stages 2 and 3 with epochs, GPU resources, training durations, gradient accumulation, and other hyperparameters. v2 adds a code/pretrained-model access URL and explicitly identifies xBD Set 1 and fMoW as supervised. These disclosures do not establish underlying training changes.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 75 works and retain the same research positioning. Expanded venue names and added citation back-references are bibliographic presentation changes.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized wording and caption edits, changes the appendix heading hierarchy, and moves the bibliography after the appendices. Most explanatory prose and the main narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: v2 adds the training-details table, expands comparison and ablation tables, compresses the change-detection table, and rearranges appendix displays. Figure A.2 repeats the retained main-text Figure 4; the qualitative comparison and failure figures are relocated and renumbered rather than newly introduced.

improvement.justification: The larger detection comparator, more informative ablation controls, and stage-2/3 training disclosures modestly improve evaluation and reproducibility. Reporting inconsistencies limit the gain: revised GeoChat-Instruct multiple-object mAP is 13.41 in Table 6 while Table 13 retains 15.03, without explanation. The substantial score revisions themselves do not establish better or worse paper quality.
